en: Multi-view color postcard bordered in brown showing a busy spa resort with crowded outdoor thermal pools and conical shingle-roofed pavilions, an indoor/outdoor bath complex, a modernist hotel building, and a general aerial view of the resort grounds. A pink lotus flower is inset at center, a symbol of the thermal lakes. The reverse is a Romanian postcard with postage and handwritten Romanian message.
